title: Construction Review | $500M Bir Al-Abd Arish Railway Advances As Egypt Extends Sinai Development Train
summary: A US-French consortium led by Parsons Corporation has won management of the $2.75 billion Riyadh Metro Red Line extension. The Royal Commission for Riyadh City picked the group, Riyadh Metro Transit Consultants, in March. The appointment was announced on Monday by Parsons.
